Game Overview

In Bouncing Squirrel, the core idea is straightforward: guide a lively squirrel on an acorn-collecting quest, bouncing through vibrant levels filled with challenging puzzles. Maneuver skillfully using paddles, destroy bricks, and aim for high scores. With intuitive controls and endless fun, Bouncing Squirrel delivers a perfect mix of strategy, reflexes, and charm.
